text: 北交所做市商队伍再度扩容。近日，证监会核准长城证券、东莞证券上市证券做市交易（限于北京证券交易所股票做市交易）业务资格，两家公司同日拿到批文。至此，年内拿下北交所做市“入场券”的券商已增至7家，全行业具备该业务资格的券商达30家。（中国基金报）
text_en: The Beijing Stock Exchange market maker roster has expanded again. The CSRC recently approved the qualifications of Great Wall Securities and Dongguan Securities for listed securities market-making trading (limited to market-making trading of Beijing Stock Exchange stocks), with both companies receiving approval on the same day. With this, the number of securities firms obtaining the BSE market-making "entry ticket" this year has risen to 7, and the industry-wide total of securities firms with this business qualification has reached 30. (China Fund News)
